hook_stat.sub: Immigrant visas issued in February 2026, about half the pre-Trump monthly average of 52,000

stats.label: Immigrant visas for Indian nationals in February 2026
Countries now facing travel or visa restrictions
Employment-based immigrant visas in February 2026, nearly steady

diaspora_bullets: India is not on any ban list, but consular processing is slower
Employment-based green card pathways remain the steadiest channel
news_summary: The State Department issued 26,483 immigrant visas in February 2026, about half the pre-Trump monthly average of roughly 52,000, as restrictions came to cover 91 countries and immigrant visas for Indian nationals fell 16%.
payoff: Employment-based immigrant visas held nearly steady, while the collapse was concentrated in family reunification and the diversity lottery.
